FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
WHERE orders.order_status = 'DELIVERED';

11.question: Who are the top 5 customers by total amount spent (quantity times unit price, all orders)? Show full name and total spent.
11.sql:
SELECT c.full_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 5;

16.question: For each customer tier, how many customers are there and how many orders have they placed in total?

    c.customer_tier,

22.question: Which customers have spent more than the average spend per customer (quantity times unit price, counting only customers who have ordered)? Show full name.
22.sql:
WITH customer_spending AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        c.full_name,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spend
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name
)
SELECT full_name
FROM customer_spending
WHERE total_spend > (SELECT AVG(total_spend) FROM customer_spending);
22.detail: 23 row(s) identical to the reference answer

23.question: Which customers have reviewed a product that they never ordered? Show the customer's full name and the product name.
23.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.full_name, p.product_name
FROM reviews r
JOIN customers c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN products p ON r.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.customer_id = r.customer_id
      AND oi.product_id = r.product_id
);
23.detail: 81 row(s) identical to the reference answer
